name: firmly
description: Agentic commerce API that lets AI agents search merchant catalogs, build carts and check out natively at firmly merchants, with card, wallet and network-token payments.

skills.name: Search Merchant Catalogs
skills.description: Searches products across firmly merchant catalogs with filters for domain, price, availability and variant attributes.

skills.name: Build Carts
skills.description: Adds line items, add-ons and promo codes to a merchant cart and sets shipping before checkout.

skills.name: Check Out Natively
skills.description: Completes the order on the merchant's own platform, paying by card, PayPal, Google Pay or Klarna.

skills.name: Pay with Network Tokens
skills.description: Enrolls a card and authorizes agent payments with Visa, Mastercard or Discover network tokens through Agentic Pay.
